column1: # note: The 2025 Tax Computation Worksheet, for taxable income (K-40 line 7) of $100,001 and over: line 7 times .0558, less $175 (married filing joint) or $87 (single, head of household, married filing separate). Written, as the federal worksheet is, as a negative base with of_excess_over 0.
# note: The K-40 says to enter amounts in whole dollars only (page 20); the test rounds line 8 so.
# note: Hand-transcribed from the PDF and checked against its text twice.
